sections.text: Each line is a change (its hosts, why and what it does: below). To make them, after your security approval, list the lines in fapolicyd_approved (the template's Variables) exactly as here and run the job again - a Check run first shows what it would change. Trust file: that file, as it is now (its size and sha256: a changed file is a new line), added to the job's own trust file. Allow rule: a container's file, to the job's own rules file. Remove rule: the rule commented out in its file, marked. A change that blocks more is made only while fapolicyd is permissive.
